title: Allocation (Building-Level)
description: A building's stock-search configuration. Building id is meant to match the same building id in Topology-as-Code, same convention as facility.id.

api_version.description: Schema generation this allocation document conforms to. Declared on the building because that is this repo's self-contained, independently loadable scope - the same role warehouse.yaml plays in Topology-as-Code. A future incompatible change to this repo's schemas raises the version instead of silently reinterpreting existing data.

imports.description: Relative paths to further YAML files (structure/, strategies/).
